_readme: Reviewed by the team (see reviewed_by and reviewed_on). Phrases are matched as whole words after lowercasing and removing punctuation, so 'bunuh diri' also matches 'aku ingin bunuh diri.'. A match shows the support screen and skips the AI. A false positive only shows a gentle support screen; a miss is worse, so err on the side of including a phrase. Update reviewed_by and reviewed_on (YYYY-MM-DD) every time the list changes; npm run db:seed-safety refuses to load it when they are empty.
